business.name: Ridgeline Mobile Detailing
business.description: We detail cars, trucks and boats at your home or office, so you never have to drop it off.

customers.who: busy homeowners, small fleet owners (contractors, realtors), and boat owners in spring
common_requests: price for a full interior and exterior detail
customers.price_range: $150 to $450 per vehicle, fleet deals by quote

voice.sample: Hi there, thanks for reaching out! A full detail on a mid-size SUV runs $275 and takes about 3 hours. I have Thursday morning or Saturday afternoon open. Which works better? Thanks, Dana

dream_automation: Every evening, look at tomorrow's bookings and draft a reminder text for each customer with the time window and what to have ready (keys, vehicle unlocked, water spigot).
